items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: Did Nicholas play with you or any of those people? ... Yes. Later, two or three times, with a different band

ctx.x: I was afraid to play with Bechet. He was so great musician.
Did Nicholas play with you or any of those people?
Yes. Later, two or three times, with a different band, the band which I play now every Sunday.
